# Cantus melody fixtures

One row from each public Cantus melody-search response, retrieved 20 October 2026.
The header count is reduced to one to match the extracted row. Source and chant
links remain in the HTML. These fixtures exercise the parser without network access.

- [Cantus melody search](https://cantusindex.org/melody)
- [Cantus Index licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)

The tune and chant texts are historical material; the source database and its
contributors are credited by the retained links.
